GAP [1]: The mechanism by which osimertinib causes cell death in T790M-resistant NSCLC cells is unknown.
GAP [2]: No study has tested whether NUAK1 phosphorylates NADK under conditions of ROS accumulation and subsequent osimertinib resistance.
GAP [3]: It is unclear whether the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway acts upstream or downstream of telomere maintenance via telomerase reactivation in osimertinib-resistant NSCLC cells.
GAP [4]: The causal path by which bevacizumab affects cell growth and tumor effusion is missing experimental validation of the intermediate between these two outcomes.
GAP [5]: No study has tested whether comprehensive liquid biopsy analysis can identify molecular alterations in CTCs under conditions of heterogeneous treatment responses.
